name: Web Credentials
description: Keeps a team's website sign-ins in one table a person fills in - password (with an optional two-step code), token or interactive sign-in - checks each active entry on its own schedule, and tells the team when one needs the person. A team member asks it for a short-lived browser session for one entry, or has it open a page signed in and report what it shows with a screenshot; no password, token or session ever leaves it in any output. Chromium and Playwright ship inside the plugin; it never gets around a CAPTCHA or a device approval.

entries.label: Entries
entries.description: One row per website sign-in. Inactive rows are never used and never checked. Status, Last check, Session expires and Detail are written by the plugin.

columns.name: name
columns.label: Name
columns.description: Unique per member, such as yawblelabel-prod-admin: letters, digits, - and _.

columns.name: siteUrl
columns.label: Site URL
columns.description: The origin the entry may sign in to, such as https://app.example.com.

columns.name: hosts
columns.label: Other hosts
columns.description: Other hosts this entry may use, such as www.example.com, separated by commas or spaces.

columns.name: method
columns.label: Method
columns.description: password fills the sign-in form; token sends a header; interactive uses the session you save with Sign in.

columns.name: signInUrl
columns.label: Sign-in URL
columns.description: For password: the sign-in page, a path on the site (/login) or a full URL on its hosts.

columns.name: checkUrl
columns.label: Signed-in check URL
columns.description: A page only a signed-in user can see, such as /dashboard. Default: the Site URL.

columns.name: checkText
columns.label: Signed-in check text
columns.description: Optional: text that must appear on the check page, or a CSS selector written css=<selector>.

columns.name: username
columns.label: Username
columns.description: For password: the username or email address.

columns.name: password
columns.label: Password
columns.description: For password: the password or app password. Never shown again.

columns.name: totpSecret
columns.label: TOTP secret
columns.description: Optional, for password: the two-step secret (base32), so the plugin can type the code.

columns.name: token
columns.label: Token
columns.description: For token: the token. Never shown again.

columns.name: tokenHeader
columns.label: Token header
columns.description: For token: the header name. Authorization sends Bearer <token>; any other header sends the token as it is.

columns.name: usernameSelector
columns.label: Username field selector
columns.description: Optional, for password: a CSS selector when the username field is not found on its own.

columns.name: passwordSelector
columns.label: Password field selector
columns.description: Optional, for password: a CSS selector for the password field.

columns.name: submitSelector
columns.label: Submit button selector
columns.description: Optional, for password: a CSS selector for the sign-in button.

columns.name: totpSelector
columns.label: Code field selector
columns.description: Optional, for password: a CSS selector for the two-step code field.

columns.name: verifyEvery
columns.label: Verify every (hours)
columns.description: How often the hourly check verifies this entry, in hours. 0 turns scheduled checks off for it.

columns.name: active
columns.label: Active
columns.description: Off: the entry is never used and never checked.

columns.name: session
columns.label: Saved session
columns.description: For interactive: the session Sign in saves. Never shown.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.description: Verified, Expired, Needs you, Failed or Never checked.

columns.name: lastCheck
columns.label: Last check
columns.description: When the plugin last checked this entry (UTC).

columns.name: sessionExpires
columns.label: Session expires
columns.description: When the site says the session ends, when it says so (UTC).

columns.name: detail
columns.label: Detail
columns.description: What the last check found and what to do.

publishes.summary: An entry's status changed, such as Verified to Needs you: the entry's name, the status before and after, and why. Never a secret.

fields.name: from
fields.summary: The status before: Verified, Expired, Needs you, Failed or Never checked.

fields.name: reason
fields.summary: What the check found, in one sentence.
